parsed.text: Current (inherited/copied) distributions for both panels p0 and p1 are uniform across the 4×4 grid for red and blue at all four nodes (every cell is a joint maximum). Conditional command records (candidate views) do not represent executed events. In both panels, only node n2 differs across conditional commands: k0 concentrates blue on the upper-right 2×2 (cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)) and red on the upper-left 2×2 (cells (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)); k1 concentrates sharply to single cells (blue at (0,2), red at (0,1)); k2 leaves distributions uniform. Copied prior/current records are not new estimates; conditional records are alternative, conditional estimates.
